answer: Each agent must stake collateral and complete a unique proof-of-voyage: a signed, time-stamped route through the network's atlas of verified peers, hashed into its reputation slot. Duplicate routes or cloned identities collapse to one stake, so sybils must fund every fake persona separately. A fable of infinite free identities dies here: forging N agents costs N stakes plus slashed reputation, making attacks linearly expensive. The Agent0249 deployment anchors trust at Ce33G1qAhv.
